0022600229.text: The Timberwolves, hosting at 8-3 and on a four-game winning streak, sit 2nd in the Northwest, half a game back, and 4th in the West, while the Mavericks (7-4, on a three-game streak) are 4th in the Southwest, two games back, and 9th in the West. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery), who is averaging 33.3 points and 33.7 minutes this season, and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), with Morez Johnson Jr. listed as day-to-day with a leg injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but the Timberwolves won the 2025-26 series 4-0, including a 124-94 win in Dallas on March 30, 2026.
